title: Letter to the Council of Carthage
english: And they signed. May our Lord keep you for us for very many years, most blessed brother. Likewise signed Alypius, Augustine, Possidius, Marinus, and the rest of the bishops.

Here begin the replies of Cyril, bishop of the Alexandrians, to the synod in Africa, in which he sent through Innocent the presbyter the authentic acts of the council at Nicaea translated from the Greek — which letters, together with the council of Nicaea, were sent through the aforementioned presbyter Innocent and Marcellus the subdeacon of the church at Carthage to the most holy Boniface, bishop of the Roman church, on the sixth day before the kalends
translator_notes: Copy-text: PG 77; Ad Carthaginiense concilium (Khazarzar). PD.
True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
Letter sending authentic Nicene copies to the African synod; four tip sections cover the whole letter, mid-sentence breaks continuing across rows.
